jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a German comic pixel-art RPG HUD. Square 1536x1536 image. STRICT three-column, three-row grid, NINE isolated sprites centered exactly in their equal 512x512 cells. Genuinely transparent alpha background, generous 64px empty margin inside every cell. NO grid lines, text, numbers, labels or background. This is one sprite sheet, not a mockup. Exquisite chunky hand-painted pixel art, crisp stepped contours and confident pixel clusters, strong readability when reduced to 32–64 px, warm rustic tavern materials, forest-green outlines, antique brass edge lights, deep shadows. Rich confident material shading, few restrained glints. Avoid photorealism, smooth vectors, 3D, noisy microdetail and faded pastels. Front-facing three-quarter objects, consistent upper-left light. ROW 1: large ornate emblem objects, no square icon frames. ROW 2: small EMPTY/INACTIVE resource tokens. ROW 3: matching FULL/ACTIVE tokens, IDENTICAL silhouettes, position and alignment to row 2. Activity changes material fill and light, not position. Dosen-Dieter, pub brawler/tank. COLUMN 1 guard: row1 wooden beer-barrel lid shield with iron bands, brass rivets, central bronze bottle cap and little door key; row2 small dark unlit shield medallion; row3 identical shield medallion full of glowing amber protection. COLUMN 2 bottle-cap stacks: row1 three serrated bronze bottle caps on a dark oak pub tally plaque with decorative notches (no text); row2 ONE dark tarnished bottle cap, face-on; row3 IDENTICAL cap with polished golden brass inset. COLUMN 3 brewing: row1 handsome squat oak beer keg with steel hoops, brass tap, golden froth and hops; row2 small dark closed keg with no froth; row3 IDENTICAL keg active with bright oak, amber tap and compact white foam crown. Honey amber, burnished copper, oak brown, forest green. Exactly nine isolated sprites.
